meta.descricao: The live class room of the Training School: the video and the class chat, for activists only.

sala.naoEncontrada: This class does not exist, was canceled or is not for this account.
sala.falha: The room did not open right now.
sala.semServico: This site has no account service: the room does not open here.
sala.avisoTocador: The video comes from YouTube, through the address without advertising cookies. Nothing from Google loads before you click. When you click, Google sees your internet address (IP). If that is a risk for you, watch through a VPN or the Tor Browser.
sala.semTransmissao: The stream has not been created yet. When the person leading creates it, the video shows up here.
sala.antes: The class starts {quando}. The chat opens half an hour before.
sala.avisar: Let me know when it starts
sala.desavisar: No need to let me know
sala.avisoLigado: Done: a notice arrives when the class starts.
sala.naoRepasse: Do not pass on the video address: “unlisted” does not mean secret. Anyone with the link can watch it on YouTube.
sala.doCaderno: This live class belongs to the notebook lesson {codigo}.

chat.sobre: Only activists read it. You appear by your Alumia code name. The chat is deleted 30 days after the class.
chat.ehPergunta: It is a question for the person leading
chat.fechado: The class is over: the chat is closed.
chat.antesDeAbrir: The chat opens half an hour before the class.
chat.semCodinome: To speak, confirm your code name on Alumia. Your legal name never appears here.
chat.ficouEsperando: Your message is waiting for the person leading the class.
chat.recusada: This message cannot be published: it breaks the house rules.
chat.devagar: Too many messages in a row. Wait a little and try again.
chat.erro: The message did not go through. Try again.

gravacao.texto: The School's live class about this lesson was recorded. Only activists receive the video.
gravacao.naoRepasse: “Unlisted” does not mean secret: do not pass on the video address.

painel.caixaAjuda: The class does not appear on the public schedule or to anyone who is not an activist. The video runs on YouTube as unlisted, and the chat is for activists only, by code name.
painel.limite: “Unlisted” is not secret: anyone with the link can watch it on YouTube. What closes the class is that the site only gives the video address to activists.
painel.camera: Show only the person teaching on camera; never film the class. The title goes to YouTube: no names of people, places or actions.
painel.chatDoYoutube: Turn off YouTube's own chat for this stream, in YouTube Studio. The YouTube API has no way for the site to turn it off by itself: the class conversation is the site's.
painel.aulaLivreAjuda: What comes after /escola/formacao/{caderno}/ in the lesson address. It can stay empty.
painel.naAgenda: It does not appear on the public schedule: only activists see it, inside the School.
painel.gravacaoNaAula: When you end it, the recording goes into the notebook lesson by itself.
